title: fix(context): correct I6-B work budgets and received digest validation
body:
Correct the two Medium findings from #152. This Draft PR targets its actual review branch directly. Author verification is complete; separate non-Author re-review is pending and no independent PASS or Release acceptance is claimed.

| Finding | Correction | Before → after |
| --- | --- | --- |
| I6B-IR-M01 | Reserve cumulative work before scanner traversal, allocation, escaping and embedded parsing; check fixed root cardinality before key-set allocation. Retain complete semantic units and hard caps. | Saved 1,001-row zero/small-budget fixture: 1,501 embedded parses / 314,392 characters → zero / zero. Charged totals for budgets 0/1/17/exhausted prior17: 1/2/18/18. New scanner regressions 16. |
| I6B-IR-M02 | Verify received dictionary digest before selection conversion through the existing shared canonical encoder; refuse noncanonical selections against existing `to_dict()` authority. | Saved stale-digest 30: accepted → DIGEST_MISMATCH. Correctly rehashed changed duplicate/permuted selections: INVALID_SELECTION. Canonical inputs retain compatibility. New regressions 40. |

Base: `review/adr0031-i6b-independent-20261023` @ `8521158f2996f125d2fcaac36ea79ac1296a7cf7`, tree `455ef25606ee555e4154dd2d14929b41aa4ef50f` (unchanged target). Publication HEAD `61e44291e293f773904a0127606e20c8cb83c95e`, tree `4aa8ddf49fb52d0b903db0b0bfce00ccea2fae0c`. Executable freeze `fe9e48bfac750a276b2622da2c50d3d4559de338`, tree `8ef254ff060f44f02370a695743c7a581e7b9b5c`; all 487 runtime/test/script/workflow/config inputs are byte-identical at publication. Evidence/prose commits do not change those inputs.

[Author REPORT](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/61e44291e293f773904a0127606e20c8cb83c95e/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-m01-m02-20261023/REPORT.md) · [finding response](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/61e44291e293f773904a0127606e20c8cb83c95e/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-m01-m02-20261023/findings-response.json) · [R/V/T matrix](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/61e44291e293f773904a0127606e20c8cb83c95e/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-m01-m02-20261023/MATRIX.md) · [artifact index](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/blob/61e44291e293f773904a0127606e20c8cb83c95e/docs/implementation/evidence/adr0031-i6b-m01-m02-20261023/ARTIFACTS.json)

Validation:

- One final-source ordinary invocation: **6,344 unique = 6,045 PASS / 279 FAIL / 20 ERROR, exit1**, zero skip/xfail/xpass. Baseline was 5,989/279/20. All 6,288 old nodes retain outcomes/phases, all 56 additions pass; the same 299 unsuccessful nodes retain actual exception/refusal/frame-function signatures. Initial JUnit presentation differences and the one shifted line coordinate remain documented.
- Separate diagnostic 745: 446/279/20 exit1. All call-phase assertion entry sets match; all 299 unsuccessful all-phase sets match. Two passing setup associations vary under worker scheduling; global assertion-entry set matches. This is statement-entry observation, not subexpression/thread/child coverage.
- Unchanged saved 33: baseline 33 FAIL → corrected 33 PASS. Unchanged independent normal 208 and Author 34 PASS separately. Safety 626 (including I4 217/I5 29), wire 212 and new 56 PASS as overlapping subsets of the full invocation, not added totals.
- Each separate installed direct/sdist-derived wheel: safety 626, wire 212, independent 204 + V07 alternatives 4, Author 34, saved 33 and new 56 PASS/exit0, exact node/JUnit/journal/phase reconciliation. Original Access smoke **FAIL1, child/pytest exit1 PERMISSION_DENIED** in both; subsequent original assertions remain unexecuted.
- Both wheel archives match all 164 members; actual product 160 files / 6,025,551 bytes, metadata, all archive/installed RECORD entries and actual external site-packages origins checked. Wheel SHA256 `2452e419e06eea774805fc89358130538c50fdd313fdb0fb9b82b230e99a39d8`; sdist SHA256 `96134d412faf97119c50e98845c494f6a4554ea67d22d328da0a314049f8fbd7`. Both builds use the same complete frozen fe9 source. Existing sdist rules omit 120 historical artifacts evidence files: exhaustive retention failure and exact paths preserved, all product inputs retained. These Author artifacts predate the evidence publication. The final-HEAD Access CI subsequently built and exercised publication artifacts as recorded below; this does not turn its failed lanes into acceptance.
- Python 3.12.14 actually loads SQLite 3.53.1; no alternate SQLite acquisition/build/swap or floor relaxation. Static policy/schema/boundary/callsite/lint/format checks exit0. Existing tests/assertions, Accepted ADRs, authority, both Transfer fences and historical evidence are unchanged. No sibling #144/#147/#150 integration.

Final-HEAD CI (exact feature/actual merge checked):

- [Development 39975300074](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39975300074): **SUCCESS**; both sqlite-policy/offline success. Actual receipt 91,302 bytes, SHA256 `b9380f4201eed5f20f2b5e05c40e6b5de2e3c194b428e441b3d4ca72a441f15d`, all 21 indexed payloads verified. Actual checkout `99477234735b9f45cbb4d0634bb8372eaf120710` has ordered parents base `8521158f2996f125d2fcaac36ea79ac1296a7cf7` / feature `61e44291e293f773904a0127606e20c8cb83c95e`; effective tree `4aa8ddf49fb52d0b903db0b0bfce00ccea2fae0c` equals the feature. Manifest `development_checks_passed`, `full_acceptance=false`, hosted product-pytest cases 0. CI actually uses Python 3.12.15 / SQLite 3.53.1, distinct from cloud Author Python 3.12.14 / SQLite 3.53.1.
- [Access 39975300189](https://github.com/TakashiSasaki/git-repo-db/actions/runs/39975300189): **FAILURE** (terminal). Main **2,487 PASS / 279 FAIL / 20 ERROR**, separate overlapping I5 broad **2,849 PASS / 279 FAIL / 20 ERROR**; each exit1, no simple sum. Both 299 unsuccessful sets/outcomes/primary-message-first-lines/refusal codes match final source. Full messages match 280/299 (temporary paths differ), rendered frame projections 135/299; this is not a claim of identical complete traceback or assertion reach in CI. Actual receipt **1,953,448 bytes**, SHA256 `436c4c647bdf7943e23ef341700c73f412a8d93600bb71cbd1f1ad30d44ce37a`, all **121 indexed payloads** verified against exact feature/base/merge/tree. Each supported raw log view is missing 90 bytes; retained, observed-only complementary chunks recover the exact original receipt hash (no inferred bytes or full artifact download).
- Final publication-tree CI distribution observations: clean archive checkout `99477234735b9f45cbb4d0634bb8372eaf120710` / tree `4aa8ddf49fb52d0b903db0b0bfce00ccea2fae0c` actually built direct wheel + sdist + derived wheel and installed both, build/install exits0. Both wheels are 791,300 bytes with the same Author wheel SHA256 `2452e419e06eea774805fc89358130538c50fdd313fdb0fb9b82b230e99a39d8`; publication clean-archive sdist is **167,509,792 bytes**, SHA256 `352bf204122e726e5702b3bbbf4661ad118dd9cb01007a30ab452ac9d227a9e9`, a distinct artifact from the Author fe9 sdist. Each installed I4 217 and I5 29 PASS; I2/I3 scripts exit0. Original Access smoke remains exit1 `PERMISSION_DENIED` at unconnected export in both, downstream assertions unexecuted. CI's Python-module inventory scope (158 .py files) is narrower than the Author's whole product inventory (160 files); these scopes are not conflated. Runtime/installed/packaging/ledger steps retain their actual failures; no hosted full runtime/Release acceptance follows.
- The new 56 M01/M02 regression nodes are absent from every hosted Access JUnit lane (0 hosted correction cases); their source/direct-wheel/sdist-derived-wheel passes are the separately retained Author fe9 executions. Full-member/metadata/RECORD checks are also attributed to those Author executions.
- Release workflow for this HEAD: **never run**; Development success does not mean Release acceptance. Historical #151 Development39955068751 SUCCESS / Access39955068823 FAILURE and #152 Development39963122681 SUCCESS remain historical.

Final CI logs/metadata and pure receipt verification outputs are retained externally at `/workspace/i6b-fix-final-ci` and the linked actual GitHub runs. External SUMMARY.json SHA256 `8b60ff2e8c8ee4944f1288f70178b49ed5032859d0368abc6b597483f860c4df`, CI INDEX.json SHA256 `fdd8db5cfce0eb76631047d796db694bc9592afc6fe8fc71183b0fd73468671a`. New evidence ARTIFACTS.json SHA256 `0b61941f15bc83166267807c0eb664e663309a1068e375fe6af99cea4a79de5e` verifies all 1,151 payloads (1,152 files including index). All 487 executable inputs remain identical to the tested freeze; no circular final-CI evidence commit.

Remaining: known 299 source non-successes, original Access smoke, existing 120-file sdist omission, two live/benchmark opt-ins, independent re-review, I6-C/I7/I8, normal Transfer activation, stack integration and full hosted Release acceptance. No merge/release/deploy or fence retirement is performed.
